verdict.rationale: Ledgy's financial reporting module claims one-click reports that account for equity under US GAAP (the ASC 718 framework), as well as IFRS 2 and UK GAAP, with tranche-level detail. Configurable settings, custom overrides, aggregate grouping and exports support producing accountant-ready output. The evidence is marketing-level only. missing for 10: explicit naming of ASC 718 expense reports, documentation of auditor-ready outputs or audit trail, detail on expense calculation methodology, independent or hands-on corroboration.
